title: Multiply binomials
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review

hints.poly.multiply.binomials: Every term times every term: x·x, x·(second number), (first number)·x, and the two numbers. Then combine the two x terms.
hints.poly.multiply.leading: Same four products: the first terms, outer, inner, last. Multiply the numbers in front of x too.
hints.poly.multiply: Four products (first, outer, inner, last), then combine the two x terms.

misconceptionMessages.poly.foil-middle: There are four products, not two: don't forget the two x terms in the middle. (x + 4)² = x² + 8x + 16.
misconceptionMessages.poly.foil-last-added: The last two numbers are multiplied, not added: (x + 3)(x + 5) ends in 3 × 5 = 15.
misconceptionMessages.poly.foil-one-middle: The middle term comes from two products, outer AND inner. Add them both.

similarProblemIntro: Here's the worked solution. Now try one like it.

sections.title: Multiply (x + a)(x + b)
sections.objective: Multiply binomials like (x + 3)(x + 5) with the box method.
explain: Every term in the first binomial multiplies every term in the second: four products.
Two of them are x terms: add them together.

visual.caption: Tap to fill each box, then combine.

sections.key: Four products: first terms, outer, inner, last. Then combine the two x terms: (x + 3)(x + 5) = x² + 8x + 15.

sections.title: Multiply (ax + b)(cx + d)
explain: The same four products. Now the numbers in front of x multiply too: 2x · 3x = 6x².
sections.key: Same four products. Multiply the numbers in front of x as well, and keep every sign.
